checkout.title: We are opening Stripe
checkout.lead: We will take you to a secure Stripe page to complete payment.
checkout.notice: We could not open the payment automatically. Start a new booking or contact Pixkuy.
checkout.errorTitle: We could not open the payment
checkout.errorLead: The payment session is not available or has expired.

confirmed.title: Your reservation is confirmed
confirmed.lead: Your vehicle is reserved. Keep the reservation code for any coordination with Pixkuy.
confirmed.notice: You will receive a confirmation email with the booking summary. The date and time correspond to Mexico City.

pending.title: We are verifying your payment
pending.lead: Stripe may take a few moments to notify the result. If you already paid, wait a moment and refresh this page.
pending.notice: The reservation will only be confirmed once payment is completed successfully.

manualReview.title: Your reservation requires review
manualReview.lead: We detected a situation that the Pixkuy team must review before confirming the reservation.
manualReview.defaultNotice: Contact Pixkuy if you need to clarify this reservation status.
manualReview.paymentMismatchNotice: The amount paid does not match the expected amount. The reservation has not been confirmed automatically.
manualReview.paymentAfterExpiryNotice: The payment arrived when the temporary booking window was no longer valid. We will review the case manually.

expired.title: The temporary booking has expired
expired.lead: The payment window is no longer active. To book, start the process again or contact Pixkuy.
expired.notice: No reservation has been confirmed with this status.

unknown.title: We could not confirm the status
unknown.lead: The response received does not allow us to show a clear confirmation. Contact Pixkuy to review your case.
unknown.notice: No reservation has been confirmed from this screen.

missingToken.title: We cannot check this reservation
missingToken.lead: The public reservation token is missing from the URL. Open again the link received after payment.
missingToken.notice: No backend query has been made.

notFound.title: We could not find this reservation
notFound.lead: The link does not correspond to an available public reservation or is no longer valid.
notFound.notice: Check the link or contact Pixkuy.

requestError.title: We could not check the status
requestError.lead: There was a problem connecting to Booking API. Try again in a few moments.
requestError.notice: No reservation has been confirmed from this screen.

pending.title: The payment was not completed
pending.lead: Your temporary booking may remain active for a few minutes. If you want to keep this request, you can retry payment.
pending.notice: The reservation will only be confirmed once payment is completed successfully.

confirmed.title: Your reservation is already confirmed
confirmed.lead: Even if you returned from the payment screen, your reservation is already confirmed.
confirmed.notice: Your payment is already recorded. Keep the reservation code for any coordination with Pixkuy.

manualReview.title: This reservation requires review
manualReview.lead: We cannot open a new payment automatically because the reservation requires operational review.
manualReview.defaultNotice: Contact Pixkuy to review the case.
manualReview.paymentMismatchNotice: The amount paid does not match the expected amount. The reservation has not been confirmed automatically.
manualReview.paymentAfterExpiryNotice: The payment arrived when the temporary booking window was no longer valid. We will review the case manually.

expired.title: The temporary booking has expired
expired.lead: The payment window is no longer active. To book, start a new request.
expired.notice: We do not reactivate expired reservations from this screen.

cancelled.title: This reservation has been cancelled
cancelled.lead: The previous reservation is no longer active. If you need the service, start a new request.
cancelled.notice: We do not reactivate cancelled reservations or keep the previous time slot.

unknown.title: We could not confirm the status
unknown.lead: The response received does not allow us to know whether you can retry payment.
unknown.notice: Contact Pixkuy if you need to review this reservation.

missingToken.title: We cannot check this reservation
missingToken.lead: The public reservation token is missing from the URL.
missingToken.notice: Payment cannot be retried without a valid token.

notFound.title: We could not find this reservation
notFound.lead: The link does not correspond to an available public reservation or is no longer valid.
notFound.notice: Check the link or start a new request.

requestError.title: We could not check the status
requestError.lead: There was a problem connecting to Booking API.
requestError.notice: We cannot enable payment retry until the real status is checked.

retry.loadingNotice: We are requesting a new payment link for this temporary reservation.
retry.error: A new payment could not be opened. The temporary window may have expired. Try creating a new reservation or contact Pixkuy.

pending.title: The payment was not completed
pending.lead: If the temporary booking is still active, you can reopen payment.
pending.notice: The reservation is only confirmed when Stripe and Pixkuy confirm payment.

confirmed.title: Your reservation is already confirmed
confirmed.lead: Even if you returned from the payment screen, your reservation is already confirmed.
confirmed.emailNotice: You will receive a confirmation email at {{email}}.
confirmed.timezoneNotice: The date and time correspond to Mexico City.

expired.title: The temporary booking expired
expired.lead: The payment window is no longer active. Start a new request.
expired.notice: No charge has been made and no reservation has been confirmed.

cancelled.title: Reservation cancelled
cancelled.lead: This reservation is no longer active. Start a new request if you need the service.
cancelled.notice: The previous time slot is not kept.
